name: @hh/engine
description: Pure, versioned load engine shared by the web app and the API. No I/O, no Date objects.

scripts.test:tz: for tz in UTC America/Chicago America/New_York Pacific/Auckland Asia/Kolkata Pacific/Kiritimati Etc/GMT+12; do echo "TZ=$tz"; TZ=$tz vitest run --reporter=dot || exit 1; done
